name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A scroll-snap carousel with native momentum, mouse drag and arrow keys. Its dot stretches between pages as you scroll and its edges fade only where there is more.
docs: Import Carousel from components/eased/carousel/carousel. Set --carousel-inset on a parent to inset the slides and footer. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
